lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co3Bi crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms (Co6Bi2) distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Bi and Co centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors; Bi is surrounded by 12 Co neighbors (2.523–2.597 Å), while Co has 4 Bi and 8 Co neighbors (2.476–2.597 Å). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include Co–Co 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Bi–Co polyhedra sharing edges.
